about: The directory checklist this box ships with. Edit it from Integrations → SEO Ops → Directories: the setting is JSON of the same shape and is MERGED over this file by id, so an entry here can be renamed, re-tiered or removed (state it with "drop": true) and new ones added, without editing the app. Nothing here is specific to any owner or any business.

fields.id: kebab, stable, the ledger's join key. Renaming one orphans its rows.
fields.name: what a person calls it
fields.url: where a human goes to submit. Never fetched by this box.
fields.tier: saas | app | code | press | general — which kind of product the directory is for, so a checklist for a Python library is not forty red marks about app stores.
fields.detect: the presence source id whose detection may move this row forward, or null for a directory nothing here can probe. A null is the ordinary case and is not a gap.
fields.note: what an absence from it is worth.

directories.name: Product Hunt
directories.note: A launch, not a listing. The probe fetches the conventional product url for the name, so a listing under a different slug reads as absent.

directories.name: G2
directories.note: Pages exist for products that never submitted. A detection here is evidence a page exists, not that it is yours.

directories.name: Capterra
directories.note: Not probed from here at all — the presence collector records it blocked with the reason every run.

directories.name: GetApp
directories.note: Shares Gartner's vendor pipeline with Capterra; one submission usually feeds both.

directories.name: Software Advice
directories.note: Same pipeline again. Worth one row so the owner can mark it skipped once rather than wondering each quarter.

directories.name: AlternativeTo
directories.note: Community-editable: an entry may already exist that somebody else created.

directories.name: SaaSHub
directories.note: Free listing; the backlink is nofollow.

directories.name: Slant
directories.note: Answers rather than listings — the row is really 'is this product named in the relevant question'.

directories.name: BetaList
directories.note: Pre-launch only. Mark it skipped once the product has launched.

directories.name: Indie Hackers products
directories.note: A product page tied to a person, not a company.

directories.name: Crunchbase
directories.note: An organisation record. Free tier is enough to claim and edit one.

directories.name: Wikidata
directories.note: Notability rules apply and most small products do not meet them. `skipped` is usually the honest state.

directories.name: Wikipedia
directories.note: Do not create an article about your own product. This row exists to record that a page exists, not as a task.

directories.name: GitHub
directories.note: Counted present only when a repository names the brand AND its homepage is the product's host.

directories.name: PyPI
directories.note: Only meaningful for a Python package.

directories.name: npm
directories.note: Only meaningful for a JavaScript package. Not probed by the presence collector.

directories.name: Apple App Store
directories.note: Detected through iTunes Search, accepted only when the seller url is the product's host.

directories.name: Google Play
directories.note: Not probed here. The mobile plugin reads a store account you own; this row is the checklist entry.

directories.name: Hacker News (Show HN)
directories.note: A post, not a listing. Detected only when a story points at the product's host.

directories.name: Relevant subreddit
directories.note: Deliberately vague: which subreddit is a judgement, and the note field is where it belongs.

directories.name: F6S
directories.note: Startup profile. Useful mostly as an indexed page carrying the name.

directories.name: SourceForge
directories.note: Still indexed heavily. Only worth a row for downloadable software.
